text:
nina (PM): Quick call: need to lock DP recruitment approach. two options: "wide" (7 light partners, docs + 2 office hours) or "narrow" (3 deep partners with private hooks). pick today so eng can scope.

raj (Eng): narrow = 3 sprints (VPC+SSO+UI). wide = 1 sprint (telemetry + runbook). wide is lower delivery risk.

clare (Solutions): Sales has 2 narrow asks for strategic accounts. Others prefer fast access. can we do wide + offer 2 priority slots for narrow?

li (ProdResearch): signal: wide gives more prompt diversity which helps evals. narrow gives deeper infra validation. telemetry must be mandatory either way.

zoe (Legal): private deploys need a one-page addendum. can draft in 48h. include anonymized telemetry consent.

ops-bot: Reminder: DP staging deploy scheduled 2024-09-10T22:00Z (1755555600). toggle migrations if needed.

nina (PM): proposal: run wide-by-default, reserved 2 priority narrow seats. Acceptance gates for wide: 1) partner signs pilot terms; 2) telemetry enabled (req_id + sample); 3) smoke run within 5 business days; 4) <=2 high-sev regressions.

raj (Eng): add fallback: if narrow partner converts mid-pilot, we prioritize and may pause new wide invites. also latency SLO: p50 < 150ms OR auto-fallback to hosted model.

clare (Solutions): i'll add intake checkbox "apply for priority narrow seat" and a short intake question about SSO/VPC needs.

li (ProdResearch): measurement plan: onboard_time, active_requests/week, eval_regressions, partner_sat (0-10). T+2 & T+6 surveys. i'll prepare templates.

nina (PM): actions: Clare -> intake checkbox + invite draft by EOD. Raj -> telemetry estimate + fallback plan by Tue. Li -> survey + dashboard slice by Wed. Zoe -> addendum draft for narrow seats by Thu. meeting Thu 11:00 to finalize. :white_check_mark:
